recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring two men in black leather jackets against a stylized, graphic background. The composition uses a central circular emblem at the top and bold, outlined lettering at the bottom, framed by a horizontal bar and a large, dark paw-print silhouette in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects in the foreground overlapping a large graphic silhouette
Top-aligned circular emblem balanced by bottom-aligned heavy display type
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a neutral, slightly textured backdrop
coreInvariants: Black leather textures with visible highlights
Yellow display text with thick black outlines
Concentric blue and white circles as a top anchor
Horizontal black bar dividing the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures positioned in the lower two-thirds, one slightly behind the other, filling the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A circular blue emblem at the top center serves as the primary focal point for the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top emblem, move down through the subjects' faces, and rest on the large yellow lettering at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark grey (leather jackets and background silhouette)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and light grey (background and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright yellow text and the dark clothing; low saturation except for the primary accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded display script and brush-style casuals
letterConstructionRules: Thick black outer stroke with a secondary thin white inner glow
Slightly italicized or slanted posture for the bottom text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Brush-like, jagged edges for the top emblem text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A casual brush script for the top emblem paired with a heavy, stylized display script for the bottom name.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and rounded feel for the bottom text.
Approximates the casual, hand-drawn look of the top emblem text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of two men in black leather jackets and beanies, posing with a serious expression. Behind them is a large, dark grey paw-print silhouette on a light grey textured wall. A horizontal black bar runs across the top third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a blue circular emblem with white rings at the top center. Inside the circle, place yellow brush-style text. At the bottom, add large, bold, yellow display lettering with a thick black outline, slightly overlapping the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow text high-contrast against the black jackets?
Is the circular emblem centered at the top?
Does the background feature the large paw-print silhouette?
Are the leather textures on the jackets visible and highlighted?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text has a distinct black outline.
Verify the subjects are wearing black leather jackets.
Check that the circular emblem is the primary top anchor.
Confirm the background is a light, textured neutral color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast urban portraiture with heavy, outlined yellow display type and a central circular graphic anchor.
